about_the_game:
Experience a taste of the expansive world in 'Seed of the World: Seeding,' our demo designed to give you a firsthand feel of the gameplay before committing to the full purchase.

As we continue to develop the game in Early Access, this demo offers a snapshot of the rich class variety awaiting your exploration. Dive into the demo without time or level constraints, freely venturing through the starting village and its surrounding forest—representing just under 10% of the full game. If you find joy in this preview, be sure to hit 'Wishlist' and support us on our journey.
